game.q: epictetus never wrote a book. so how do we know what he taught?
opts: a student wrote down his talks
he scratched hot takes on walls

wrong.pod: two thousand years too early. close in spirit, though.
wrong.walls: no hot takes. a student took careful notes.

game.right: YES. his student arrian wrote down the talks, then boiled them into a little handbook.

end.line: an old story says his master broke his leg, and his calm answer grew into a whole way of living.
end.l1: some things aren’t up to you.

cliff.s1: a freed teacher loses his city.
cliff.s2: then his lamp. his answer is pure epictetus.
cliff.tmr: tomorrow: the thief and the lamp.

share: “you will break it,” he said. he was right. epictetus on infinite hill
